title: The Weir Keeper
author: Lina Hargrove
summary: A lock keeper's daughter in a 1920s river town finds the ledger her father hid.
body: A lock keeper's daughter in a 1920s river town finds the ledger her father hid.
pick_note: The book club pick for November, and the author is speaking at Central on Saturday.

title: Salt Roads
author: Teodor Brann
summary: How the old salt trade routes became the highways we drive today.
body: How the old salt trade routes became the highways we drive today.
pick_note: Has a chapter on the county turnpike.

title: A Quiet Kind of Weather
author: Ines Moravec
summary: Three sisters, one farmhouse, a long dry summer.
body: Three sisters, one farmhouse, a long dry summer.

title: Murder at the Lending Desk
author: P. J. Calloway
summary: A retired librarian investigates when a rare atlas goes missing.
body: A retired librarian investigates when a rare atlas goes missing.
pick_note: Yes, it is a library mystery. Yes, we noticed.

title: Small Engines, Big Repairs
author: Walt Osei
summary: Mowers, blowers and generators, fixed step by step.
body: Mowers, blowers and generators, fixed step by step.
pick_note: Pairs with the repair café in the makerspace.

title: Bramble and the Night Bus
author: Kit Lowan
summary: A hedgehog rides the last bus of the night and meets everyone on it.
body: A hedgehog rides the last bus of the night and meets everyone on it.
pick_note: Our most-requested storytime book this fall.

title: The Ossingford Ledger: 1874–1924
author: Ossingford County Historical Society
summary: A reprint of fifty years of front pages, with an index of names.
body: A reprint of fifty years of front pages, with an index of names.
pick_note: The index alone has answered a dozen family history questions this month.

title: Static Season
author: Jae Min-Ortiz
summary: A high-school radio station, a missing DJ, and one very long winter break.
body: A high-school radio station, a missing DJ, and one very long winter break.
pick_note: Read it, then try the recording booth.

title: The Weir Keeper (audiobook)
author: Lina Hargrove, read by Ada Brennock
summary: The November book club pick, unabridged on 9 discs.
body: The November book club pick, unabridged on 9 discs.

title: Field Guide to Ossel River Birds
author: Hal Weatherby
summary: Every bird you are likely to see on the river path, by season.
body: Every bird you are likely to see on the river path, by season.

title: Cast Iron Every Day
author: Rosa Quill
summary: One pan, 120 recipes, and how to bring a rusty skillet back.
body: One pan, 120 recipes, and how to bring a rusty skillet back.
pick_note: The holds list says we bought too few.

title: The Glass Wing
author: Odile Fane
summary: A museum guard and a forger in 1960s Lisbon. Large print.
body: A museum guard and a forger in 1960s Lisbon. Large print.

title: Sewing machine (Singer, basic)
author: Library of Things
summary: A basic sewing machine with a starter kit of thread and needles. Borrow for 2 weeks.
body: A basic sewing machine with a starter kit of thread and needles. Borrow for 2 weeks.
pick_note: Comes with a laminated threading guide.

title: Telescope (4-inch reflector)
author: Library of Things
summary: A reflector telescope with a moon map and a red flashlight. Borrow for 1 week.
body: A reflector telescope with a moon map and a red flashlight. Borrow for 1 week.

title: Rivers of the Night (film)
author: Dir. Sami Rautio
summary: A documentary that follows one barge for a week on the night shift.
body: A documentary that follows one barge for a week on the night shift.

title: Kettle Square Sessions, Volume 2
author: Various artists
summary: Live recordings from the summer concerts on Kettle Square (fictional).
body: Live recordings from the summer concerts on Kettle Square (fictional).
pick_note: Local music belongs in the local collection.

title: How to Draw Maps
author: Orla Venn
summary: Draw your street, your school and an island you made up.
body: Draw your street, your school and an island you made up.

title: Paper Lanterns
author: Saoirse Kell
summary: A short novel about a lantern maker and the fair that might not happen this year. E-book only.
